summary: The proof is complete. The endpoint centroids have explicit positive-mass metronoid representations at mass 4w, the accepted root-lift proof establishes convexity of the positive-mass set itself before closure, barycentric interpolation gives the stated feasible masses at every lattice point, and the affine selector lemma applies with the proved primitive affine hull. The common-core point, coefficient 4, and proper-rank, full-rank, and rank-zero cases all match the claimed conclusions.
